title: Channel Selection for Mixture-of-Experts Decoding Needs No Calibration Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.37386v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are bottlenecked by loading routed-expert weights from memory during interactive decoding at small batch sizes. Because most intermediate channels in a routed expert contribute little to any single token, channel selectors predict which channels matter and read only their weights, typically keeping channels above a threshold calibrated on offline data. We show that channel selection needs no calibration data. First, a calibrated threshold does not fix how much a selector reads, because the number of channels passing it varies across inputs; Prox with thresholds calibrated for an 18% read budget actually reads only 12.9% on average across our benchmarks. Second, top-k keeps each token's k highest-scoring channels and needs no calibration data. translated_title: 混合专家模型解码中的通道选择无需校准数据
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型在小批量交互式解码过程中，因需要从内存加载路由专家权重而受到瓶颈限制。由于路由专家中的大多数中间通道对任何单个token的贡献都很小，通道选择器可以预测哪些通道是重要的，并只读取它们的权重，这通常是通过在离线数据上校准的阈值来保留通道实现的。我们证明通道选择其实不需要校准数据。首先，校准后的阈值并不能固定选择器实际读取的数量，因为通过阈值的通道数量会因输入不同而变化；为18%读取预算校准的Prox阈值，在我们的基准测试中实际平均只读取了12.9%。其次，top-k方法保留每个token得分最高的k个通道，无需任何校准数据。在校准预算下，在13%和18%两种预算的43次比较中，选择器的top-k版本在相同得分上有40次匹配或超过其阈值版本...
tldr: 混合专家模型解码中的通道选择可以用无需校准数据的top-k方法替代基于离线数据校准阈值的传统方法，在匹配或超越阈值方法性能的同时使实际读取预算更加稳定可控。
en_tdlr: Channel selection for MoE decoding can replace calibration-data-dependent thresholding with a top-k approach that requires no calibration data, matching or beating threshold-based performance while keeping the actual read budget stable and controllable.
